title: Register with Illinois Secure Choice or certify a retirement plan exemption
authority: Illinois Secure Choice Savings Program (Illinois State Treasurer)
description: Employers with five or more employees that have been in business at least two years and offer no qualified plan must register and enroll employees, or certify an exemption. The deadline for 5 to 15 employees was November 1, 2023. Penalty: $250 per employee the first year of noncompliance and $500 each year after, enforced by the Department of Revenue.

appliesWhen.description: 5 or more employees in the state

exemptions: Employers that sponsor a qualified retirement plan (they still certify the exemption)

title: Give annual sexual harassment prevention training to all employees
description: Illinois employers of any size must give annual sexual harassment prevention training to all employees (one guide says by December 31), and restaurants and bars have an additional policy requirement.
